segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hey, quick one on Northlake Manufacturing. Are you okay if I hold the renewal at 118 seats instead of quoting 125? Laura said the seven warehouse users probably won't be active until Q4.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Yeah, keep it at 118. If they add later, we can do a coterm add-on. What's the term they want?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Twelve months, July 1 through June 30. I put the 6/30 end date and the $42,480 net in the CRM yesterday, matched it on the order form this morning, and now deal desk is asking for the same billing address before they'll release the PDF.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. Use the Cleveland HQ address, not the plant address. Their AP team kicked back the invoice last year because of that.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, 4400 Brookpark Road. Payment terms stay net 30, and no uplift this year. They pushed back pretty hard on the 5 percent.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: That's fine if it closes before May 24. After that, finance may ask why we're holding price.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I'll send it today if I can. Laura also asked whether support hours change with the renewal. I told her no, same 8 to 6 Central coverage.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Good. Add that in the notes section so legal doesn't redline anything weird.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. If she signs by Friday, go-live for the extra reporting module is still June 10, right?

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Correct. Services has two half-day sessions reserved that week. Just don't promise migration work beyond the standard setup.
